message.content: It's been about four days now, and the yellowing and dark stools have gotten worse over that time. I feel very tired and lightheaded. I haven't had belly pain or fever. I don't know about itching, weight loss or urine color, since that wasn't mentioned. I have lung cancer, and I had my first immunotherapy infusion two weeks ago. I've had my gallbladder removed. I don't know of any liver problems.
